name: ghost-qa
description: Autonomous headless browser QA and self-healing verification loop for coding agents, with 8-trap Playwright inspection across desktop, tablet and mobile in light and dark.

interface.shortDescription: Headless browser QA loop for coding agents
interface.longDescription: Runs an 8-trap deep browser inspection (console, network, layout, WCAG accessibility and keyboard focus, Core Web Vitals, links, SEO, theme parity) across three viewports in light and dark, then reports a QA Health Score from A+ to F.
